newsitem.title: THAILAND: Sridhana to issue shares, debentures.
newsitem.headline: Sridhana to issue shares, debentures.

text.p: Thailand's Sridhana Finance Plc said on Friday it would raise its registered capital to 855 million baht ($34.2 million) from 621.25 million by issuing 23.375 million new shares.

Of the new shares, 21.3 million will be issued to existing shareholders at a ratio of two new shares at 10 baht each for every five old shares, Sridhana said in a filing to the Stock Exchange of Thailand.
The remaining shares would be reserved for existing shareholders, and would be issued if the shareholders chose to exercise their options on existing warrants, the company said.
Sridhana would also issue unsecured debentures worth up to two billion baht, it said.
The board would consider further details on the debenture issue later, the company said.
